lines.text: On the feast's last day, Jesus calls out that whoever believes in Him will have streams of living water.
John explains that Jesus was speaking about the Spirit, whom believers were later to receive.
Some in the crowd call Jesus the Prophet, while others object that the Christ cannot come from Samaria.
Some want to seize Jesus, but the officers return without Him and say never has anyone spoken like this man.
Nicodemus asks whether their law convicts a man without hearing him, and they say no prophet comes from Egypt.
